test_title: PYST 27: SSC GD Constable 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On: 27 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: In the secondary sector, what kinds of activities are typically carried out?

options.text: Producing finished products from raw materials

solution:
The correct answer is __**Producing finished products from raw materials**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The secondary sector of the economy is responsible for** manufacturing and processing raw materials** into finished goods or products.
 
• **Second Five-Year Plan:** Laid the foundation for industrialization and heavy industries.
 
• **Third Five-Year Plan:** Continued industrial growth and diversification into consumer goods.
 
• **Eighth Five-Year Plan: **Marked the beginning of economic liberalization, leading to modernization of industries.
 
• **Ninth Five-Year Plan**: Focused on technology upgrades, small industries, and infrastructure.
 
• **Eleventh Five-Year Plan**: Aimed at achieving high growth in manufacturing with a focus on competitiveness and innovation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **First Five-Year Plan (1951-1956)** Focus on Agricultural Development and Infrastructure.
 
• **Second Five-Year Plan (1956-1961)** Focus on Industrialization.
 
• **Third Five-Year Plan (1961-1966) **Focus on Self-reliance and Growth in Agriculture and Industry.
 
• **Fourth Five-Year Plan (1969-1974)** Focus on Growth with Stability, Self-reliance.
 
• **Fifth Five-Year Plan (1974-1978)** Focus on Poverty Eradication (Garibi Hatao) and Self-reliance.
 
• **Sixth Five-Year Plan (1980-1985)** Focus on Economic Liberalization, Modernization, Poverty Alleviation.
 
• **Seventh Five-Year Plan (1985-1990)** Focus on Economic Efficiency and Productivity, Modernization of Industries.
 
• **Eighth Five-Year Plan (1992-1997)** Focus on Economic Liberalization and Market Reforms.
 
• **Ninth Five-Year Plan (1997-2002) **Focus on Social Justice and Equality, Infrastructure.
 
• **Tenth Five-Year Plan (2002-2007) **Focus on Inclusive Growth, Poverty Reduction.
 
• **Eleventh Five-Year Plan (2007-2012)** Focus on Faster and Inclusive Growth.
 
• **Twelfth Five-Year Plan (2012-2017) **Focus on Faster, Sustainable, and More Inclusive Growth.
 
• **After the Twelfth Plan, Five-Year Plans were discontinued. In 2015, the NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India) replaced the Planning Commission.**
